Get CBA Period Scores

Source: R/cba.R
cba_period_scores.Rd

Points each side scored in each period of a finished game (up to seven periods).

Endpoint: POST https://data-server.cbaleague.com/api/schedule-quarters/getQuarterInfo (JSON body)

Usage

cba_period_scores(schedule_id)

Arguments

schedule_id

(required) Required. CBA game id (integer), the global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx (100105799 = 2025-26 round 1). Only a finished game is served.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One row per side and played period (overtime included). An empty valid answer is a zero-row tibble with these columns, in this order (sportsdataverse-py cba_period_scores):

col_nametypedescription
schedule_idintegerCBA game id (key space: CBA games, ONE global 9-digit sequence 100xxxxxx across seasons and match types; the {scheduleId} of every game route). Stamped by the runtime from the request; null on a body parsed without it.
sidecharacterSide of the game the row belongs to: home (the API's host / home block) or away (guest / visiting block).
periodintegerPeriod number: 1-4 regulation, 5 and up overtime (the API holds up to seven periods).
pointsintegerPoints the side scored IN this period (not cumulative); overtime periods included.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in cba_seasons().

See also

Other CBA Functions: cba_best_player(), cba_best_stats(), cba_game_info(), cba_game_team_four(), cba_game_team_shots(), cba_match_types(), cba_pbp(), cba_player_advanced(), cba_player_base(), cba_player_box(), cba_player_defensive(), cba_player_extras(), cba_player_offensive(), cba_player_shots(), cba_report_status(), cba_rosters(), cba_schedule_day(), cba_schedule_month(), cba_seasons(), cba_team_basic(), cba_team_counts(), cba_team_four(), cba_team_options(), cba_team_overview(), cba_team_shots(), cba_teams()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(cba_period_scores(schedule_id = 100105799))
#> ── CBA Period Scores from data-server.cbaleague.com ───────────── hoopR 3.2.0 ──
#> ℹ Data updated: 2026-11-01 23:38:40 UTC

#>   schedule_id side  period points
#>         <int> <chr>  <int>  <int>
#> 1   100105799 home       1     25
#> 2   100105799 home       2     26
#> 3   100105799 home       3     23
#> 4   100105799 home       4     14
#> 5   100105799 away       1     19
#> 6   100105799 away       2     22
#> 7   100105799 away       3     12
#> 8   100105799 away       4     21
# }
